(a + 3b) - (2b - a) + (a - 2b) - (2b - 3a) - (3a - 2b)
PA and PB are two tangents from a point P outside the circle with center O. If A and B are points on the circle such that ∠APB = 128°, then ∠OAB is equal to:
questions.solution_en:
∠APB = 128°

In Quadrilateral PAOB:

∠APB + ∠AOB = 180° [∠PAO = ∠PBO = 90° = Angle formed between tangent and radius.]

∠AOB = 180° - 128° = 52°

In ΔAOB:

∠AOB + ∠OAB + ∠OBA = 180°

∠OAB + ∠OAB = 180° - 52° = 128° [∠OAB = ∠OBA]

∠OAB = 128°/2 = 64°

questions.q_en: A runs 25% faster than B and can allow B a lead of 12 meters to end a race in a dead heat. What is the length of the race?
questions.solution_en:
Let the speed of B be '100'

The speed of A = 100 * 25/100 = 125

The ratio of speed of A to B = 125/100 = 5: 4

Therefore, the ratio of distance covered by them will also be 5: 4

(5 - 4)unit = 12

1unit = 12

5 unit= 60

Hence, the length of the race = 60 meters

questions.q_en: If AD is altitude to the hypotenuse of a right ∆ ABC, AB = 15 cm and AC = 8 cm, then find the length of AD (to the nearest whole number).

ar (∆ABC) = ½ * base * altitude = ½ * AB * AC = ½ * AD * BC

AD = AB * AC/BC = 120/17 ≈ 7 cm

a and b are even negative numbers =>

questions.q_en: Mukul started running from one point towards another point. If he runs at the rate 15/4 km/h, he arrives the destination 12 minutes late. If Mukul traveled at the speed of 9/2 km/h, then he arrives 20 minutes early. What is distance between the two points?
questions.solution_en:
Let original time taken by Mukul to traveled from one point to another point = x hours

According to the question,

15/4 * (x + 12/60) = 9/2 * (x - 20/60)

=> 15x + 3 = 18x - 18 * 1/3

=> 3x = 9

=> x = 3 hours

So, distance between one point and another point = 15/4 * (3 + 1/5) = 12 km
questions.solution_hi:

questions.q_en: Find the area of a Quadrilateral which has a diagonal of length 10 cm and the length of the perpendiculars drawn on this diagonal from opposite vertices are 3 cm and 4 cm.
questions.solution_en:
Area of Quadrilateral ABCD = area of Δ ABD + area of Δ BCD

Area of Δ ABD = (1/2)*BD*AE

BD = 10 cm

AE = 3 cm

CF = 4 cm

Area of Δ ABD = 1*10*3/2 = 15 cm2

Area of Δ BCD = (1/2)*BD*CF

= 1*10*4/2 = 20 cm2

Area of Quadrilateral = 15 + 20 = 35 cm2
questions.solution_hi:

questions.q_en: Two trains P and Q start running from station X to station Y with the speed of 100 km/h and 80 km/h respectively. If train P starts 30 minutes later than train Q from station X and reaches station Y 30 minutes before train Q, then what is the distance between stations X and Y?
questions.solution_en:
Let the distance between stations X and Y = 'd' km

Time taken by train Q - time taken by train P = 30 + 30 = 60 minutes = 1 hour

d/80 - d/100 = 1

d/400 = 1

d = 400 km

questions.q_en: A trader sells pulses at a 32% profit and uses weights 20% less than the actual measure. Find his gain percentage.
questions.solution_en:
Cost price for 1 kg = C

He sells 1 kg but gives 0.8 kg (20% less)

Selling price = 132% of C = 1.32C

Cost of 0.8 kg = 0.8C

Profit = 1.32C - 0.8C = 0.52C

% gain = (0.52C/0.8C) * 100 = 65%

questions.q_en: If area of circle is halved when its radius is decreased by n then what will be the radius of the circle?
questions.solution_en:
Let us suppose radius of the circle be R.

Hence according to the question, (pR2/p(R-n)2) = 2/1

=> R2/(R-n)2 = 2/1

=> √2 (R-n) = R

=> √2R - R = √2n

=> R(√2-1) = √2n

=> R = √2n/(√2-1)

questions.q_en: A train of length 720 m can cross a 480 m long tunnel in 48 seconds. In how much time (in seconds) can it cross a platform of length 1280 m?
questions.solution_en:
Speed of train = (720 + 480)/48 = 1200/48

=> 25 m/sec

Time taken to cross a platform of length 1280 m

=> (720 + 1280)/25 = 80 seconds
